milestone_full: Layer R - the names we keep - is OPEN. All 171 Hong Kong chapters ship in three arms (Traditional HK / opencc Simplified fold / full English prose). Ah Ching keeps the east-gate keys; a folded race card with a pencilled name waits under the wet-floor sign, Mrs Lau returns a borrowed umbrella, and a numbered brass tag ties the three together in the lost-property book. Ten StateGraphs/lanes run in the service (world guide, Ah Wan NPC, analyst readout, EN drafting bench, fenced arc auditor, story recap, Wayfinder, arc audit, cross-chapter World Answer, real web facts). The provider cache flicker (95.3% / 0%) was measured and removed with a bounded in-process replay arm: 1 provider call + 5 zero-token replays. A 7,937-token full-corpus RAG lane and a zero-token Wikipedia facts door are live. Full AI suite 37,984 green; web 707 green; verify_all NO OFFENDER.
headline: Layer R open · 171 chapters in three arms · ten LLM lanes · cache flicker fixed · 7,937-token corpus RAG · real Wikipedia facts · every gate green.
features: D1501–D1502: chapters 167–171 land (Mrs Lau / the address / the brass latch / the first tram bell / the numbered brass tag). Arc 171 chapters, three arms; every chapter locked step with the frozen atlas (171/171/171).
D1502: real public facts door — POST /ai/v1/world/web-facts dispatches the SSRF-guarded Wikipedia tool. LIVE: 4 real rows in 1.16s, ZERO LLM tokens.
D1499: provider cache flicker measured (95.3% on 5 calls, 0% on one) then removed with a bounded process-local replay arm. LIVE via product router: 1 provider call, 5 zero-token replays.
D1497: full-corpus cross-chapter RAG (retrieve -> answer -> verify StateGraph over real chapter bodies). LIVE: 7,937 prompt tokens, grounded answer citing chapters 158+165.
D1496: parallel-session cache isolation (inflight key dimensions fixed) + Wayfinder StateGraph finally given a user door on /world.
D1491–D1492: guided play coach on /try; 368-request pressure run across 4 routes, zero failures.
privacy_note: All consumer fixtures are synthetic (demo flags); no real merchant, stall or operator is represented. /insights replay is deterministic synthetic inference, not stored user data. All REAL-HK figures are public sources with URLs inline on the handbook page.
milestone_full_zh: Layer R（記得名字的人）已開啟。全部 171 章香港系列以三語臂呈現（繁體香港／opencc 簡體／完整英文）。阿晴守著東門三條鎖匙；濕地滑牌下的跑馬紙寫著別人的名字，劉太太歸還一把借去的傘，編號銅牌把三者記進遺失物冊。服務中運行十個 StateGraph／通道：世界向導、阿灣 NPC、分析師讀數、英文臂起草、圍欄章節稽核、故事回顧、Wayfinder、章節稽核、全語料問答、真實聯網資料。實測並修掉快取抖動（95.3%／0%）：有界進程內重播——1 次供應商呼叫＋5 次零 token 重播。7,937-token 全語料 RAG 與零 token 維基百科資料門已上線。全套 AI 37,984 綠、web 707 綠、verify_all 全綠。
headline_zh: Layer R 開啟 · 171 章三語臂 · 十個 LLM 通道 · 快取抖動已修 · 7,937-token 語料 RAG · 真實維基資料 · 所有閘門全綠。
features_zh: D1501–D1502：第 167–171 章相繼落地（劉太太／背面地址／銅扣／第一聲電車鈴／編號銅牌）。全系列 171 章三語臂，每章與凍結圖譜鎖步（171/171/171）。
D1502：真實資料門——POST /ai/v1/world/web-facts 調度 SSRF 防護的維基百科工具。實測：4 筆真實資料、1.16 秒、零 LLM token。
D1499：實測供應商快取抖動（5 次 95.3%、1 次 0%）並以有界進程內重播修掉。產品 router 實測：1 次供應商呼叫、5 次零 token 重播。
D1497：全語料跨章節 RAG（對真實章節內文運行的 retrieve→answer→verify StateGraph）。實測：7,937 prompt tokens，答案有據引用第158／165章。
D1496：並行會話快取隔離（修好 inflight 鍵維度）＋ Wayfinder StateGraph 終於在 /world 有了使用者入口。
D1491–D1492：/try 帶玩教練；4 條路由 368 請求壓力測試，零失敗。
